symptoms: payment provider hostname intermittently failed to resolve
application logs showed DNS lookup errors
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A DNS resolver configuration change introduced intermittent resolution failures for the payment provider domain.
resolution: An infrastructure DNS configuration change caused intermittent external hostname resolution failures. Reverting it restored payment traffic.
postmortem: Application restarts could not fix resolver configuration.
HTTP timeout did not affect failed name resolution.
